descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S14 「通过界面，每类动作（view、save、generate、handoff send）都留下一行，写明病人、医生、时间和动作，两个模式」 Through the screens, each action class (view, save, generate, handoff send) leaves a row naming patient, physician, time and action, in both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send …（UAT OAT-01 step 5；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 7；TFA-94513 AC 12；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The lane C fixture (one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident) plus a second @roundai.test physician as handoff recipient

When In each mode: open the chart (view); type pre-round text and press Save Note (save); press Generate on the encounter (generate); send the handoff in-app to the second physician (handoff send)

Then Each action leaves at least one audit row from this run that matches its predicate: the patient (patient_id), the physician (actor_id), a timestamp and an action that tells view, save, generate and handoff send apart. The view rows name the Hospital patient with context rounding.patient and the resident with context snf.patient, and no row names the other p …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：spec.auditCheck predicates per action class against U5 and UAT 3.3. A missing row, a missing patient_id or actor_id, or a row naming the other patient = Fail. The generate predicate is the ai_disclosure row, not the PHI_WRITE row written when the note is stored, so storing the note cannot pass 'generate'. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
